# The Usual Suspects

> Bar and kitchen at 46 Thompson Street, Raritan, New Jersey (NJ) 08869, in Somerset County. Modern American food with Italian and Albanian favorites, cocktails, an all-day happy hour, weekly karaoke and live music, a patio with a tiki bar, and private parties.

## Key facts

- Name: The Usual Suspects (also written Usual Suspects Bar & Kitchen)
- Address: 46 Thompson Street, Raritan, New Jersey (NJ) 08869, USA
- Town: Raritan, New Jersey. Nearby: Somerville, Bridgewater, Manville and Bound Brook, New Jersey
- Phone: (908) 382-8613
- Email: usualsuspectnj@gmail.com
- Website: https://usualsuspectsnj.com/
- Hours: Tuesday to Thursday noon to 10 PM, Friday and Saturday noon to midnight, Sunday noon to 8 PM. Closed Mondays.
- Kitchen: until 10 PM, until 8 PM on Sundays
- Price range: $$ (appetizers $6 to $19, handhelds $13 to $18, entrees $19 to $29)
- Reservations: yes, by phone; parties of 8 or more by email
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/usualsuspectsnj

## Weekly events

- Wednesday: Karaoke Wednesdays with DJ Melly Mel, 8 PM, no cover
- Thursday: Single Ladies night, half off pours, 8 PM
- Friday: Espresso Martini Night
- Saturday: Live Acoustic Night, 8 PM to 11 PM
- Sunday: NFL games on every screen with the volume up

## Happy hour

Happy hour runs from open to close.

- $5: Select drafts, Surfside, High Noon, Spiked Ade and house liquors
- $7: Skyy vodka, Cazadores tequila, Bacardí rum, Four Roses bourbon and Dewar’s scotch

## Private parties

A section of the house is reserved for Christmas parties, birthdays, bachelorettes and other group events, any day the bar is open. Capacity: 20 bar seats, 40 high-top seats, 16 low-top seats. Book by email (usualsuspectnj@gmail.com) or phone ((908) 382-8613).

## Food menu (prices in USD)

### Appetizers

- Caesar Salad ($13): Crisp hearts of romaine with shaved parmesan cheese, garlic and croutons, served with classic caesar dressing.
- Mixed Greens Salad ($14): Apples, glazed walnuts, crumbled gorgonzola and cranberries.
- Long Hots ($10): Charred, with roasted garlic and extra virgin olive oil.
- House-Made Rice Balls ($15): Panko crusted risotto stuffed with melty mozzarella cheese in a silky blush pink sauce.
- Oven Roasted Meatballs ($10): Three hand rolled, slow simmered meatballs in a light brown gravy.
- Hot Mess Wings ($12 / 19): Crispy and flavorful, tossed in a vibrant, tangy sauce.
- Stick It & Dip It ($14): Breaded mozzarella sticks: crunchy, stretchy and seriously cheesy.
- Bavarian Pretzel ($10): Straight out the oven, served with creamy melted cheese.
- Soup of the Week ($6)
- The Catch ($15): Crusted coconut shrimp with an island golden homemade sauce.
- Disco Fries ($12): Served classic style with savory brown gravy, velvety rich cheese and frizzled onions.
- Fried Calamari ($18): Tossed in a house made dressing, your choice of sweet and spicy or traditional.
- Loaded Nachos ($16): Choice of beef or chicken, with pico de gallo, beans, guac, sour cream and long hots.

### Handhelds

- Back Room Chicken Melt ($14): Flame grilled chicken and a trio of cheeses pressed in a warm tortilla.
- Chicken Sliders ($13): Three sliders with American cheese and house sauce.
- Nonna's Meatball Sub ($18): Hand rolled meatballs with slow simmered marinara, melted mozzarella and charred Italian long hots. Served with fries or a salad.
- The "OG" ($18): Crispy chicken breast, fire roasted red pepper, mozzarella and sweet balsamic glaze on oven warmed giambotta bread. Served with fries or a salad.
- The Festival ($18): Sweet Italian sausage, roasted bell peppers, onions and roasted garlic on warm bread. Served with fries or a salad.
- Raritan Smash Burger ($17): Custom blend beef patty with yellow American cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion and a pickle. Served with fries or a salad.
- Tacos ($16): Three tacos with your choice of chicken, beef or cod.

### Entrées

- Spicy Situation ($24): Rigatoni in a velvety blush vodka sauce with a slight kick.
- The Holy Parm ($25): Chicken in Italian breadcrumbs with melted mozzarella and your choice of creamy vodka sauce or traditional marinara.
- Uncle Lou's Giambotta ($29): Sweet Italian sausage, slow roasted meatballs, red peppers, onions, mushrooms, charred long hots and golden roasted potatoes.
- Beef Qebapa ($23): Albanian house crafted beef links with your choice of fries or salad.
- Fettucini Bolognese ($25): Fettuccine tossed in a rich, savory bolognese sauce.
- Butternut Squash Ravioli ($19): Hazelnut light cream sauce with chopped walnuts.
- Atlantic Grilled Salmon ($28): Glazed in honey garlic sauce with roasted red potatoes and garden vegetables.

## Drinks

- Domestic beers are $5 (Bud, Bud Light, Coors Light, Michelob Ultra, Miller Lite, Sam Adams, Yuengling). Imports are $6 (Corona, Heineken, Heineken 0.0, Modelo, Stella Artois).
- Wine by the glass from $9 and by the bottle from $34: cabernet sauvignon, pinot noir, chardonnay, sauvignon blanc, pinot grigio and rosé.
- Full bar with vodka, gin, rum, tequila, bourbon, whiskey, scotch and cognac.

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is The Usual Suspects in Raritan, New Jersey?

The Usual Suspects Bar & Kitchen is at 46 Thompson Street, Raritan, New Jersey (NJ) 08869, in Somerset County. Look for the pink neon sign.

### What are the opening hours?

We are open Tuesday to Thursday noon to 10 PM, Friday and Saturday noon to midnight, Sunday noon to 8 PM. Closed Mondays. The kitchen serves until 10 PM, and until 8 PM on Sundays.

### Is there a happy hour in Raritan, New Jersey?

Yes. The Usual Suspects in Raritan, New Jersey runs happy hour from open to close, every day it is open. $5 gets you select drafts, Surfside, High Noon, Spiked Ade or house liquors. $7 gets you Skyy vodka, Cazadores tequila, Bacardí rum, Four Roses bourbon or Dewar’s scotch.

### What is on each night of the week?

Wednesdays are Karaoke Wednesdays with DJ Melly Mel from 8 PM, with no cover. Thursdays are Single Ladies night with half off pours from 8 PM. Fridays are Espresso Martini Night. Saturdays are Live Acoustic Night from 8 to 11 PM. Sundays we show the NFL games with the volume up.

### Can I book a Christmas party, birthday or private event in Raritan, New Jersey?

Yes. We reserve a section of the house for your party, any day we are open. The room has 20 bar seats, 40 high-top seats and 16 low-top seats. Email usualsuspectnj@gmail.com or call (908) 382-8613 to book.

### What kind of food do you serve?

Modern American bar food with Italian and Albanian favorites. Popular dishes include the Raritan Smash Burger ($17), Spicy Situation rigatoni in vodka sauce ($24), The Holy Parm chicken parm ($25), Beef Qebapa Albanian beef links ($23), Hot Mess Wings and Fried Calamari.

### Do you take reservations?

Yes. Call (908) 382-8613 to book a table. For parties of 8 or more, email usualsuspectnj@gmail.com.

### Is there outdoor seating?

Yes. There is a patio with a tiki bar, string lights and TVs.

### Is there live music or karaoke in Raritan, New Jersey?

Yes. The Usual Suspects in Raritan, New Jersey has karaoke every Wednesday from 8 PM and a live acoustic night every Saturday from 8 to 11 PM.
